newsitem.title: USA: Borders Group Inc Q3 Oct 31 loss narrows.
newsitem.headline: Borders Group Inc Q3 Oct 31 loss narrows.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)

NOTE: Borders Group includes Borders Inc 140 superstores, which reported third quarter sales of $212.0, up 42.3 percent over the same period last year. Same-store sales for the quarter rose 8.6 percent. Waldenbooks, a mall retailer, had third quarter sales of $197.9 million, down from $205.7 million for the same quarter of last year. Same-store sales fell 0.2 percent.
Further details on third quarter results will be provided during a press release and conference call on November 14, Borders said.
